question: What alternative modes of cakra placement are permitted to the practitioner?
premises: Placement may be done in one way or another.
Both cakra placements are addressed to the beloved.
inference: Either of two sixfold cakra placements may be performed.
uncertainties: The specific distinction between the two placements is not detailed here.
plain_english: O beloved, having placed in one way or having placed in another, both sixfold cakra placements may be done.
